exposure: duration of labor greater than 24 h
cohort: The study included 107 cases of women with meconium-stained amniotic fluid and 214 controls, all of whom delivered at four southwestern referral hospitals in southwest Ethiopia.
finding: Induction of labor, obstructed labor, labor duration greater than 24 hours, and premature rupture of the membrane were significantly associated with meconium-stained amniotic fluid.
